entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Yeah, I need to return my VeloBand. It's garbage.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
The pulse reading is completely wrong. It's useless. Look, I don't have time to play 20 questions. Can I return it or not?
I understand your frustration. When you say the pulse reading is wrong, what are you seeing? Sometimes a simple software update can fix sensor calibration...
I'm not doing that. I don't have time to be your IT department. I just want my money back. It doesn't work. I want a refund.
Okay, I understand you'd prefer to return it. I just need to pull up your account to verify the purchase date. Can I get your name and email address?
Thank you, Mike. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It looks like it was delivered 25 days ago, on December 15th.
So? Am I getting the refund?
Let me just check our return policy for you... Yes, it looks like you are well within the 90-day return window.

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email on file now. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll process your full refund.
Fine. I'll watch for the email.
It should be there within the next five minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mike?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
